data.title: 时崎狂三 · 旧书店午后
data.description: 【时崎狂三 · 旧书店午后】弥漫着尘封墨香的二手书店角落，午后斜阳穿透彩色玻璃窗洒在沉睡的旧书架上。狂三倚在窗台旁静静翻阅着泛黄的画册，黑发在光影中泛着丝绸般的光泽——「过去的记忆总是这般厚重而脆弱。不过，与您一同度过的这段时间，倒是非常值得放进书页里珍藏呢。」
data.promptProse: Leaning against the old bookstore's window sill, Kurumi supports a yellowed art album with one hand and lifts a single page corner with the other. Her red-and-gold eyes remain absorbed above her loose black cardigan. The medium view places shelving behind her and stained glass beside the album. Slanting afternoon light crosses the illustrations and catches drifting dust, while the sill and shelf recesses keep their supporting shadows.
